description: This Java source file defines the CommonEvents class, which contains various static methods for handling common web application events such as setting user preferences (locale, timezone, theme), generating CAPTCHA images, handling JWT tokens, opening source files for debugging, and responding with JSON or JavaScript. It acts as a utility event handler in the Apache OFBiz framework, providing server-side logic for user interactions and debugging support.

classes.name: CommonEvents
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to handle common web events such as setting user preferences, CAPTCHA generation, JWT handling, source code viewing, and JSON/JavaScript responses within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setSessionLocale
methods.description: Sets the user's session locale based on the 'newLocale' request parameter and updates the user login object if present.

methods.name: setSessionTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the user's session time zone based on the 'tzId' request parameter and updates the user login object if present.

methods.name: setSessionTheme
methods.description: Sets the user's session theme based on the 'userPrefValue' request parameter.

methods.name: setSessionCurrencyUom
methods.description: Sets the user's session currency unit of measure based on the 'currencyUom' request parameter and updates the user login object if present.

methods.name: jsResponseFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a JavaScript snippet by filename from cache and writes it to the HTTP response.

methods.name: jsonResponseFromRequestAttributes
methods.description: Collects request attributes, filters out ignored attributes, and outputs a JSON response.

methods.name: writeJSONtoResponse
methods.description: Helper method that writes a JSON object as a string to the HTTP response with proper headers.

methods.name: getCaptcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image, stores the code in session, and writes the image to response.

methods.name: loadJWT
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for the authenticated user and outputs it as JSON.

methods.name: openSourceFile
methods.description: Opens a source file for debugging purposes when widget dev namedBorder is SOURCE, executes a command to view the file.
